title: Market Stack
owner: src/platform/audio.ts (Audio). The kit plays its own button, cash-out and win sounds.

events.label: Crate lands
events.trigger: A crate is placed on the stack.
events.prompt: A light slatted fruit crate landing on another crate: thin hollow wooden slats clacking with a short dry rattle and a soft muffled thud of fruit shifting inside, light not heavy, brief and clean, close mic, 0.4 seconds, no deep boom, no timber beam, no crack, no music, no voice

events.label: Tower collapses
events.trigger: The stack topples and the round is lost.
events.prompt: A tall stack of light slatted fruit crates toppling over: a quick burst of thin hollow wooden clacks and slat rattle with fruit tumbling out, light and clattery, collapsing fast and stopping within half a second, close mic, 0.6 seconds total, no deep boom, no heavy timber, no glass, no debris tail, no music, no voice

events.label: Payout
events.trigger: Cash out is collected. The game leaves it silent: the browser UI plays its own jingle.
events.prompt: A small handful of coins dropping into a metal cash tray, bright satisfying brief jingling clinks settling, close mic, under one second, no voices or music.

events.label: Splash
events.trigger: A crate falls into the water.
events.prompt: Short water splash for a dropped crate.

events.label: Background loop
events.trigger: Loops in the background while Music is on.
events.prompt: Calm looping background music bed for a casual mobile market game: gentle warm marimba and soft acoustic guitar plucks over a light shaker groove, sunny and relaxed, mid tempo, no drums build, no vocals, no melody climax, stays in the background, seamless 30 second loop, consistent from start to end
